products.name: DESK COMMANDER
products.shortDescription: A native Commander X16 desktop with Notes, Calendar, Desk Directory, Files, Text Editor, network chat and Market Watch.
products.description:
Desk Commander
A Modern Desktop Experience for the Commander X16

Bring a whole new level of functionality to your Commander X16 with Desk Commander, a native graphical desktop environment that transforms your favorite 8-bit computer into a powerful, intuitive, and enjoyable personal computing experience.

Inspired by the golden age of home computing, Desk Commander combines the charm of classic graphical operating systems with modern usability. Featuring a graphical application launcher, SD-card file management, a built-in Rolodex, animated screensavers, and keyboard and mouse support, it provides a unified environment for exploring and using your X16.

Built specifically for the Commander X16's 65C02 processor and VERA graphics system, Desk Commander runs directly on real hardware—not as an emulation or a retro-themed imitation. Its lightweight, modular architecture takes advantage of banked memory to deliver a responsive desktop experience while respecting the capabilities of an authentic 8-bit machine.

Features

- Graphical Desktop: A classic, intuitive interface designed specifically for the Commander X16.
- Application Launcher: Browse and launch your favorite X16 programs and games from one convenient location.
- SD-Card File Management: Navigate directories and manage files through a graphical interface.
- Built-in Rolodex: Organize contacts and personal information with a retro-inspired digital address book.
- Animated Screensavers: Enjoy custom graphical animations that showcase the X16's VERA capabilities.
- Keyboard & Mouse Support: Navigate naturally using familiar desktop controls.
- Modular Architecture: Efficient banked-memory design supporting independent applications and utilities.
- Expandable Ecosystem: Includes Network Setup, direct and group chat, and Market Watch with compatible networking hardware.

Your X16. Your Desktop.

Desk Commander is more than an application launcher. It's the foundation for a growing ecosystem of native Commander X16 software, bringing productivity, entertainment, and graphical computing together in one cohesive experience.

Rediscover what an 8-bit computer can do.

Platform: Commander X16  
Developer: RODDY  
Category: Software / Desktop Environment  
Status: 0.3.1 alpha

Install and update

Download the purchased DESK COMMANDER X16 ZIP, then extract it into the root of a FAT32 SD card. Keep all files inside DESKCMD together. Open DESKCMD/AUTOBOOT.X16 from your X16 launcher. From BASIC, enter these commands separately:

CD "DESKCMD"
LOAD "DCMAIN.PRG",8,1
RUN

Targets Commander X16 ROM r49. This is X16 software, not a Windows or Linux desktop app. Before updating, exit Desk Commander and back up your DESKCMD folder, including DCSTATE.BIN and your documents. Replace program files while preserving your saved data. The ZIP includes README.TXT with setup and controls.

Connect Wi-Fi and chat

Offline apps work without networking. Online features require the TexElec Commander X16 Serial & ESP32 Network Card running ZiModem. The supported configuration is IO7-low $9FE0, 115200 baud, 8N1, RTS/CTS, with Option Pin A high.

1. Open Network Setup: D detects the card, W scans for Wi-Fi, select your network, J joins, and I checks connection status.
2. Open Comms. HOST is already set to 143-244-168-180.sslip.io. No host search or manual entry is needed on a fresh install. Blank saved hosts fill automatically on upgrade; a custom host stays unchanged. To switch a custom host back, use HOST and enter this hostname without https:// or a path.
3. Choose USER, enter a username and an 8–24 character password, then press SYNC. A new name creates an account; an existing name requires that account's password.
4. Open the square conversation selector and choose WELCOME. Type in the bottom field; Enter or SEND sends your message.
5. Use +FR to add a friend, +GRP to create a group, and MEM to manage group membership. DEL removes a selected friend or leaves/removes a group according to your permissions. The face picker adds emoji. Friend indicators show green online, yellow away and red offline.

You can also use the browser chat tester: https://console.143-244-168-180.sslip.io/chat/ with the same account and conversations. Chat requires an internet connection and the selected server to be available. Desk Commander does not save your Wi-Fi password; ZiModem may remember its own configuration.

Everyday controls

- Desktop: click an app, or select with arrows and Enter. Esc or the red X closes the current app. Use arrows, mouse wheel or scrollbars in scrollable views.
- Files: Enter/Open opens a selection; N creates a file, F a folder, R renames, M moves, D deletes and U goes up. Opening a PRG/X16 program exits Desk Commander to run it; reopen Desk Commander afterward. Raw binaries need their own loader.
- Text Editor ++: F2 saves and F4 opens Save As. Text files are limited to 2,047 bytes; larger/binary files are rejected rather than partially overwritten.
- Notes: select a note and press Enter to read it, then choose Edit to change it. Arrows/wheel scroll the reader; Tab moves between actions.
- Calendar: click a date or dashboard event to open details. Done or Esc saves event text and closes the editor.
- Desk Directory: type to search, Insert adds a contact and Enter edits. Open the card to read every field, including long email addresses.
- Settings: cycle themes and mouse styles; choices save to the SD card. Sound can be muted here.
- Market Watch: needs networking. The default current-price feed needs no key; KEY accepts an optional Finnhub API key. Quotes depend on the upstream feed and are not a trading terminal.

Alpha notes and account privacy

This is an alpha release. Keep backups; physical SD recovery and long-session behavior still need more hardware testing. The masked chat password is stored in DCSTATE.BIN, so use a unique password and keep the SD card private. ZiModem HTTPS encrypts traffic but does not verify server certificates. Chat is not end-to-end encrypted; the selected server can read messages. Never include your saved state in a shared ZIP.
products.releaseNote: 0.3.1 alpha: official chat HOST prefilled as 143-244-168-180.sslip.io; blank saved hosts migrate automatically and custom hosts are preserved. Includes chat wrapping/dialog fixes and README.TXT setup instructions. Extract the purchased X16 ZIP into the SD-card root and launch DESKCMD/AUTOBOOT.X16. Back up DCSTATE.BIN before upgrading.

products.story: We created Desk Commander because we believe the Commander X16 deserves more than a command prompt. Inspired by the classic graphical desktops that made early personal computers so exciting, we wanted to bring that same sense of discovery, creativity, and accessibility to modern 8-bit computing. Desk Commander is our way of making the X16 feel like a complete personal computer again—not just a machine for running games, but a platform for exploring, creating, and getting things done. It's about pushing the boundaries of what 8-bit hardware can do while celebrating everything that made those early computers special.

products.name: I KNOW WHAT I SAW
products.description:
# I KNOW WHAT I SAW
**Something is out there. You know what you saw.**

*An original retro-inspired game for PC and ESP32.*

There's something special about games that leave a little to the imagination. The strange things you catch out of the corner of your eye. The mysteries you can't quite explain. That feeling that something is out there, even when nobody else believes you.

**I KNOW WHAT I SAW** is an original indie game from RODDY that embraces the charm, simplicity, and imagination of classic gaming while bringing the experience to both modern PCs and tiny ESP32-powered devices.

Built with a passion for retro computing, independent game development, and unconventional hardware, I KNOW WHAT I SAW celebrates the idea that a memorable gaming experience doesn't require cutting-edge graphics, enormous downloads, or expensive equipment.

### A Little Mystery. A Lot of Imagination.

Sometimes the most memorable games aren't the ones that show you everything. They're the ones that make you curious, encourage you to explore, and leave you wondering what might happen next.

I KNOW WHAT I SAW draws on that spirit of discovery, combining a distinctive retro aesthetic with the personality of a truly independent project.

It's a game built to be enjoyed for what it is: something original, unusual, and made by someone who genuinely loves games.

### From Your Desktop to the Palm of Your Hand

Why should an original game be limited to one type of hardware?

I KNOW WHAT I SAW is developed in C with versions for PC and ESP32, demonstrating how a single creative idea can find a home on very different computing platforms.

On PC, it brings a retro-inspired gaming experience to familiar desktop hardware. On ESP32, it explores the possibilities of compact microcontrollers as genuine gaming platforms.

That cross-platform philosophy is at the heart of RODDY: build interesting things, experiment with hardware, and make software that goes beyond conventional expectations.

### Built for the Love of Games

I KNOW WHAT I SAW isn't the product of a massive studio or a corporate franchise. It's an independent creation driven by curiosity, experimentation, and a lifelong appreciation for the games and computers that inspired generations of developers.

Every RODDY project begins with a simple question: *What would be fun to build?*

Sometimes the answer is a new piece of hardware. Sometimes it's a useful application. And sometimes it's a strange little game that simply needs to exist.

I KNOW WHAT I SAW is one of those games.

### Why We Made It

We believe gaming should still be a place for experimentation, imagination, and unexpected ideas.

We created I KNOW WHAT I SAW to celebrate independent game development and prove that compelling software can be built for everything from full-sized computers to inexpensive microcontrollers.

It's about keeping the creative spirit of early game development alive—when hardware limitations were invitations to invent something clever, and a great idea mattered more than a massive production budget.

**You saw something. You know you did.**

*I KNOW WHAT I SAW.*

---

**Your desk. Your workspace. Your world.**

Whether you're writing code, designing circuits, building your next big project, or spending the night exploring your favorite retro games, the **RODDY Desk Mat** gives your workspace a place to call home.

We wanted something that belonged in that environment. Not another piece of disposable merchandise, but a useful everyday accessory that represents the people who love making things.

The RODDY Desk Mat is for the builders, the tinkerers, the programmers, and the people who never quite stop experimenting.

**Make something. Break something. Learn something. Build again.**

products.name: LINK COMMANDER
products.description:
# LINK COMMANDER

**Modern peripherals. Classic computers. One connection.**

Your favorite retro computer deserves a modern keyboard and mouse.

**LINK COMMANDER** is a retro peripheral interface designed to bridge the gap between modern input devices and classic computer hardware. Built for enthusiasts who love their vintage machines but appreciate the convenience of today's peripherals, LINK COMMANDER aims to make connecting your favorite keyboard and mouse easier than ever.

No need to hunt down aging keyboards, struggle with unreliable adapters, or sacrifice your preferred desktop setup just to enjoy classic computing.

### Bridge Two Generations of Technology

Designed around a flexible peripheral interface, LINK COMMANDER brings together modern USB connectivity, legacy PS/2 interfaces, and support for retro-computer connections.

With two USB ports and two PS/2 ports, the device is being developed to accommodate a variety of input configurations, including support for compatible wireless receiver dongles.

Whether you're restoring a vintage system, building a modern retro computer setup, or experimenting with new hardware, LINK COMMANDER is designed to help old and new technology work together.

### Built for Retro Enthusiasts

LINK COMMANDER is part of RODDY's growing collection of original hardware projects, developed with a simple philosophy: classic computers should remain useful, accessible, and enjoyable.

We're exploring compatibility with systems such as the Commander X16 and other retro platforms, with an emphasis on flexible connections, practical functionality, and a clean, compact design.

### Planned Features

- **2× USB-A ports** for compatible modern input devices and wireless receivers.
- **2× PS/2 ports** for legacy keyboard and mouse connectivity.
- **Retro-computer connectivity** through system-specific interfaces and adapters.
- **Wireless peripheral support** for compatible 2.4 GHz receiver-based devices.
- **Compact desktop design** that fits naturally alongside vintage hardware.
- **Expandable compatibility** as development continues.

### Modern Convenience. Retro Soul.

We love classic computers for their simplicity, personality, and the unique experience they offer. LINK COMMANDER is being built to preserve that experience while removing some of the frustrations of connecting modern peripherals.

Because enjoying yesterday's computers shouldn't mean giving up today's conveniences.

**LINK COMMANDER — Connect the Generations.**

*RODDY — Made for Makers.*

### Release / Availability

**Coming Soon — In Development**

LINK COMMANDER is an original RODDY hardware project currently in development. Hardware specifications, supported systems, compatibility, and availability are subject to change as prototyping and testing continue.

products.description:
# Terasic DE10-Nano FPGA Development Kit
**The Hardware Behind MiSTer FPGA**

The **Terasic DE10-Nano** is a powerful FPGA development board and the foundation of the popular **MiSTer FPGA** open-source retro computing platform. Powered by an Intel Cyclone V SoC FPGA, the DE10-Nano makes it possible to recreate classic computers, arcade machines, and gaming consoles through hardware-based implementations rather than traditional software emulation.

Originally designed for FPGA development, education, and embedded systems engineering, the DE10-Nano has become a favorite among retro computing enthusiasts thanks to its flexibility, active community, and impressive library of MiSTer FPGA cores.

### Bring Classic Hardware Back to Life

With MiSTer FPGA, the DE10-Nano can recreate an extraordinary range of vintage systems, including:

- **Classic Computers:** Commodore 64, Amiga, Atari ST, ZX Spectrum, Apple II, and IBM PC-compatible systems.
- **Gaming Consoles:** NES, SNES, Sega Genesis/Mega Drive, Game Boy, Game Boy Advance, and many more.
- **Arcade Hardware:** Hundreds of classic arcade games recreated through community-developed FPGA cores.
- **Experimental Projects:** Explore custom processors, alternative computer architectures, and original FPGA designs.

Unlike conventional emulators, MiSTer uses programmable logic to reproduce the behavior of original hardware components, offering highly accurate timing, low latency, and authentic retro computing experiences.

### Key Features

- Intel Cyclone V SoC FPGA with dual-core ARM Cortex-A9 processor
- Approximately 110,000 programmable logic elements
- 1GB DDR3 memory
- HDMI video output
- MicroSD card support
- USB connectivity through onboard interfaces
- GPIO expansion headers for accessories and hardware projects
- Gigabit Ethernet connectivity
- Includes US power adapter

### Building Your MiSTer FPGA System

The DE10-Nano is the central component of a traditional MiSTer FPGA setup. Install the MiSTer software on a compatible microSD card, connect your peripherals, and begin exploring supported FPGA cores.

For broader compatibility with MiSTer's library, additional hardware is recommended:

- **128MB SDRAM Expansion:** Required or recommended by many advanced computer, console, and arcade cores.
- **USB Hub:** Connect keyboards, mice, controllers, and other peripherals.
- **I/O Expansion Board:** Adds optional connectivity and functionality depending on your configuration.
- **Cooling Solution:** Helps maintain stable operation during extended use.

**Important:** This product includes the DE10-Nano development board with a US power adapter. It is not a complete MiSTer FPGA system. SDRAM expansion, MiSTer accessories, and other peripherals are sold separately unless explicitly listed.

### Beyond Retro Gaming

The DE10-Nano is also a genuine development platform. Design custom digital circuits, experiment with processor architectures, develop embedded systems, and explore the possibilities of programmable hardware.

Whether you're building a MiSTer FPGA retro gaming system, recreating your favorite vintage computer, or developing your own hardware, the DE10-Nano offers a versatile foundation for exploration.

**RODDY — Retro Computing. Modern Possibilities.**
